svg.title: Kaimahi governance architecture
svg.desc: The kmx developer entry point provisions the cluster and scaffolds agents, sitting outside every request path. A Kubernetes-hosted agent then reaches models and tools through Kaimahi's governed paths, and external events reach the agent through Kaimahi's governed inbound bridge, while dashed direct paths are explicitly ungoverned.
